# Iconsax linear icon font

Integrated into CompanyPortal for local/offline rendering; not distributed as a standalone icon product.

- Icons: Iconsax by Vuesax — https://iconsax.io/ / https://vuesax.com/
- Existing font/CSS distribution: https://iconsax.gitlab.io/i/icons.css
- Font stylesheet credits: 2021, Vuesax; fontello and oslllo-svg-fixer; cheatsheet by @glenthemes.
- Official usage terms: https://docs.iconsax.io/license-and-terms/license
- Official usage manifesto: https://docs.iconsax.io/license-and-terms/usage-manifesto

The original stylesheet notice is retained. CSS and font files are copied from the portal's existing distribution, with their relative paths preserved. The official developer terms permit integrating free icons in application code with the notice retained. This notice does not grant rights beyond the upstream terms or relabel the collection as MIT-licensed.
